new_claims.statement: For an original-coordinate physical cross packet C=A[I,J] with |J|=k>=3 and full column rank, if the Pluecker row-frame admits a basis law pi with inclusion marginals <=1/2 and entropy D relative to the canonical Pluecker law, then |phi_Q(t)|<=min(1,pi^(k/2)exp((D+k)/4)Delta^(-1/2)|t|^(-k/2)) and ||p_Q||inf<=[k/(k-2)]sqrt(e)exp(D/(2k))Delta^(-1/k), with arbitrary self-curvature on both banks and arbitrary outside couplings.
For k=3, disjoint Pluecker row-basis mass delta>0 gives ||p_Q||inf<=3sqrt(e)delta^(-1/6)Delta^(-1/3), equivalently 3sqrt(e)[det(C^TC)/S_dis]^(1/6), and a continuous density.
On the overlap with account04/B02 zero-diagonal physical triple P, low-frequency L2 plus the new high-frequency t^-3/2 tail gives ||p_Q||inf<6.079354 delta^(-1/8)Delta^(-1/4)|det P|^(-1/12).
